module: luamqtt implementation of the MQTT 3.1.1 protocol: packet construction (make_packet) and parsing (parse_packet). Loaded by client.lua when version 4 is used (default).

make_packet.desc: Builds a packet from an arguments table whose type field is a packet_type (CONNECT, PUBLISH, SUBSCRIBE...).

returns.desc: Combined packet ready to send, or false and an error message.

parse_packet.desc: Parses a received packet using read_func.

returns.desc: Parsed packet (metatable packet_mt), or false and an error message.
